title: A little ray of sunshine
body: This app gives me so much peace, encouragement, serenity, and support. There’s no rush, no pressure, and it’s so interactive that it’s almost like playing a video game, which keeps me interested (I have a very short attention span with similar apps). I’ve been struggling with sticking to changes and habits I want to create and this gives me structure at a beautiful pace. Unfortunately, I don’t think I’ll be able to continue the journey past the free trial for now and I’ll really miss it. Don’t hesitate on giving it a chance, you’ll find yourself wanting more after the first day. 🤍

title: Life changing!
body: Fabulous does what it sets out to do, change your life for the better one step at a time by reinforcing habits and taking you through amazing journeys in which you discover all the wonderful things you’re capable of! Beautiful art, motivational quotes and the science to back it up, positive change is truly within ones grasp. The program deserves a 5-star rating for the life altering results, but the glitchy UI, the lack of iCloud backup for the free tier and the amount of storage it uses (no idea why there’s half a gig of documents & data) deducts 1 star. Despite these minor defects, I highly recommend this app to anyone who is looking to change their life around and be the best version of themselves!
